Let \(S=\hat\Sigma\) and \(\xi=\xi^*\). Define the soft-thresholding operator
\[
\mathcal S_a(x)=\operatorname{sign}(x)(|x|-a)_+ .
\]

The numerical values requested in parts 4–5 depend on the exact omitted data-generating code for \(\xi^*\) and \(X\). The prompt states “use the given R code,” but that code is not included here, so there is no unique set of iteration counts or first 10 coordinates to report. I give below complete R code that, when run after the given data code defining `X` and `xi.star`, prints exactly the requested quantities and makes the requested plots.

---

## 1) KKT / stationary condition

The objective is
\[
Q(u)=\frac12 u^\top S u-\xi^\top u+\lambda \|u\|_1 .
\]

Since \(Q\) is convex, \(\hat u_\lambda\) is a minimizer iff
\[
0\in S\hat u_\lambda-\xi+\lambda \partial \|\hat u_\lambda\|_1 .
\]

Equivalently, there exists \(z\in\mathbb R^p\) such that
\[
S\hat u_\lambda-\xi+\lambda z=0,
\]
where
\[
z_j=
\begin{cases}
\operatorname{sign}(\hat u_{\lambda,j}), & \hat u_{\lambda,j}\neq 0,\\
\in [-1,1], & \hat u_{\lambda,j}=0.
\end{cases}
\]

Coordinatewise:
\[
(S\hat u_\lambda)_j-\xi_j=-\lambda \operatorname{sign}(\hat u_{\lambda,j})
\quad\text{if } \hat u_{\lambda,j}\neq 0,
\]
and
\[
|(S\hat u_\lambda)_j-\xi_j|\le \lambda
\quad\text{if } \hat u_{\lambda,j}=0.
\]

A useful numerical KKT residual is
\[
R(u)=\max_j r_j,
\]
where
\[
r_j=
\begin{cases}
|(Su-\xi)_j+\lambda \operatorname{sign}(u_j)|, & |u_j|>0,\\[4pt]
\big(|(Su-\xi)_j|-\lambda\big)_+, & u_j=0.
\end{cases}
\]
Then \(R(u)=0\) iff the KKT condition holds.

---

## 2) Coordinate descent update

Fix all coordinates except \(u_j\). Write the current values of the other coordinates as \(u_k^0\), \(k\neq j\). The objective as a function of \(t=u_j\) is, up to constants independent of \(t\),
\[
q_j(t)
=
\frac12 S_{jj}t^2
+
t\sum_{k\neq j} S_{jk}u_k^0
-
\xi_j t
+
\lambda |t|.
\]

Define
\[
a_j=S_{jj},
\qquad
b_j=\xi_j-\sum_{k\neq j}S_{jk}u_k^0.
\]

Then
\[
q_j(t)=\frac12 a_j t^2-b_j t+\lambda |t|+\text{const}.
\]

The one-dimensional subgradient condition is
\[
0\in a_j t-b_j+\lambda \partial |t|.
\]

Thus
\[
u_j^{\text{new}}
=
\frac{1}{S_{jj}}\mathcal S_\lambda\left(
\xi_j-\sum_{k\neq j}S_{jk}u_k^0
\right).
\]

Equivalently, using the current gradient \(g^0=Su^0-\xi\),
\[
u_j^{\text{new}}
=
\frac{1}{S_{jj}}
\mathcal S_\lambda\left(
S_{jj}u_j^0-g_j^0
\right).
\]

---

## 3) Proximal gradient update

Let
\[
h(u)=\frac12 u^\top S u-\xi^\top u.
\]
Then
\[
\nabla h(u)=Su-\xi.
\]

Given current iterate \(u^0\) and step size \(\tau>0\), the proximal gradient update is
\[
u^{+}
=
\operatorname{prox}_{\tau\lambda\|\cdot\|_1}
\left(u^0-\tau(Su^0-\xi)\right).
\]

Since the proximal map of the \(\ell_1\)-norm is soft-thresholding,
\[
u_j^{+}
=
\mathcal S_{\tau\lambda}
\left(
u_j^0-\tau\big((Su^0)_j-\xi_j\big)
\right),
\qquad j=1,\dots,p.
\]

For convergence of the fixed-step proximal gradient method, it suffices to take
\[
0<\tau\le \frac1{L},
\qquad
L=\lambda_{\max}(S).
\]

---

## 4–5) R implementation and reporting code

Run the problem’s supplied data-generating code first. It should define `X` and `xi.star`. Then run the following.

```r
## ============================================================
## Assumes the problem's supplied data-generating code has run:
##   set.seed(1)
##   n <- p <- 600
##   rho <- 0.3
##   ...
##   X <- ...
##   xi.star <- ...
## ============================================================

soft <- function(x, a) {
  sign(x) * pmax(abs(x) - a, 0)
}

objective <- function(S, xi, u, lambda) {
  as.numeric(0.5 * crossprod(u, S %*% u) - crossprod(u, xi) +
               lambda * sum(abs(u)))
}

kkt_check <- function(S, xi, u, lambda, zero.tol = 1e-8, alpha = 1) {
  g <- drop(S %*% u - xi)

  nz <- abs(u) > zero.tol
  viol <- numeric(length(u))

  if (any(nz)) {
    viol[nz] <- abs(g[nz] + lambda * sign(u[nz]))
  }

  if (any(!nz)) {
    viol[!nz] <- pmax(abs(g[!nz]) - lambda, 0)
  }

  ## Fixed-point residual:
  ## u = prox_{alpha lambda ||.||_1}(u - alpha g)
  fp <- max(abs(u - soft(u - alpha * g, alpha * lambda)))

  list(
    nnz = sum(nz),
    max_KKT_violation = max(viol),
    max_fixed_point_residual = fp
  )
}

coord_descent <- function(S, xi, lambda,
                          tol = 1e-5,
                          maxit = 10000,
                          watch = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)) {
  p <- length(xi)
  u <- numeric(p)
  Su <- numeric(p)

  if (any(diag(S) <= 0)) {
    stop("Some diagonal entries of S are nonpositive.")
  }

  traj <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = maxit + 1, ncol = length(watch))
  colnames(traj) <- paste0("j=", watch)
  traj[1, ] <- u[watch]

  obj <- numeric(maxit + 1)
  obj[1] <- objective(S, xi, u, lambda)

  l1.change <- Inf

  for (it in seq_len(maxit)) {
    u.old <- u

    for (j in seq_len(p)) {
      bj <- xi[j] - (Su[j] - S[j, j] * u[j])
      uj.new <- soft(bj, lambda) / S[j, j]

      delta <- uj.new - u[j]

      if (delta != 0) {
        u[j] <- uj.new
        Su <- Su + delta * S[, j]
      }
    }

    l1.change <- sum(abs(u - u.old))
    traj[it + 1, ] <- u[watch]
    obj[it + 1] <- objective(S, xi, u, lambda)

    if (l1.change < tol) break
  }

  traj <- traj[seq_len(it + 1), , drop = FALSE]
  obj <- obj[seq_len(it + 1)]

  list(
    u = u,
    iter = it,
    l1.change = l1.change,
    traj = traj,
    obj = obj,
    watch = watch
  )
}

prox_grad <- function(S, xi, lambda, tau,
                      tol = 1e-5,
                      maxit = 200000,
                      watch = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)) {
  p <- length(xi)
  u <- numeric(p)

  traj <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = maxit + 1, ncol = length(watch))
  colnames(traj) <- paste0("j=", watch)
  traj[1, ] <- u[watch]

  obj <- numeric(maxit + 1)
  obj[1] <- objective(S, xi, u, lambda)

  l1.change <- Inf

  for (it in seq_len(maxit)) {
    u.old <- u
    g <- drop(S %*% u.old - xi)

    u <- soft(u.old - tau * g, tau * lambda)

    l1.change <- sum(abs(u - u.old))
    traj[it + 1, ] <- u[watch]
    obj[it + 1] <- objective(S, xi, u, lambda)

    if (l1.change < tol) break
  }

  if (it == maxit && l1.change >= tol) {
    warning("Maximum number of iterations reached before convergence.")
  }

  traj <- traj[seq_len(it + 1), , drop = FALSE]
  obj <- obj[seq_len(it + 1)]

  list(
    u = u,
    iter = it,
    l1.change = l1.change,
    traj = traj,
    obj = obj,
    tau = tau,
    watch = watch
  )
}

plot_path <- function(fit, main = "") {
  matplot(
    x = seq_len(nrow(fit$traj)) - 1,
    y = fit$traj,
    type = "l",
    lty = 1,
    lwd = 2,
    xlab = "iteration",
    ylab = "component value",
    main = main
  )
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = paste0("j=", fit$watch),
    col = seq_along(fit$watch),
    lty = 1,
    lwd = 2,
    bty = "n"
  )
}

report_fit <- function(name, fit, S, xi, lambda) {
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(name, "\n")
  cat("iterations:", fit$iter, "\n")
  cat("final l1 change:", format(fit$l1.change, digits = 8), "\n")
  cat("first 10 components:\n")
  print(round(fit$u[1:10], 10))
  cat("KKT check:\n")
  print(kkt_check(S, xi, fit$u, lambda))
  cat("objective:", objective(S, xi, fit$u, lambda), "\n")
}

## Main computation
n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)

S <- crossprod(X) / n
xi <- xi.star

lambda <- 1.2 * sqrt(log(p) / n)

cat("lambda =", lambda, "\n")

L <- max(eigen(S, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values)
cat("lambda_max(S) =", L, "\n")
cat("1 / lambda_max(S) =", 1 / L, "\n")

## Coordinate descent
fit.cd <- coord_descent(S, xi, lambda, tol = 1e-5)
report_fit("Coordinate descent", fit.cd, S, xi, lambda)

## Proximal gradient
taus <- c(0.01, 0.005, 0.001)

fits.pg <- vector("list", length(taus))

for (m in seq_along(taus)) {
  tau <- taus[m]

  if (tau > 1 / L) {
    warning(paste("tau =", tau, "is larger than 1/lambda_max(S)."))
  }

  fits.pg[[m]] <- prox_grad(S, xi, lambda, tau = tau, tol = 1e-5)

  report_fit(
    paste0("Proximal gradient, tau = ", tau),
    fits.pg[[m]],
    S,
    xi,
    lambda
  )
}

## Plots of coordinates j = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot_path(fit.cd, main = "Coordinate descent")

for (m in seq_along(taus)) {
  plot_path(
    fits.pg[[m]],
    main = paste0("Proximal gradient, tau = ", taus[m])
  )
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

The stationary condition is checked by the printed quantity `max_KKT_violation`. For a successfully converged solution, this should be close to \(0\). The printed `max_fixed_point_residual` checks the equivalent proximal fixed-point condition
\[
u=\mathcal S_{\alpha\lambda}\{u-\alpha(Su-\xi)\}.
\]

  if (it == maxit && l1.change >= tol) {
    warning("Maximum number of iterations reached before convergence.")
  }

  traj <- traj[seq_len(it + 1), , drop = FALSE]
  obj <- obj[seq_len(it + 1)]

  list(
    u = u,
    iter = it,
    l1.change = l1.change,
    traj = traj,
    obj = obj,
    tau = tau,
    watch = watch
  )
}

plot_path <- function(fit, main = "") {
  matplot(
    x = seq_len(nrow(fit$traj)) - 1,
    y = fit$traj,
    type = "l",
    lty = 1,
    lwd = 2,
    xlab = "iteration",
    ylab = "component value",
    main = main
  )
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = paste0("j=", fit$watch),
    col = seq_along(fit$watch),
    lty = 1,
    lwd = 2,
    bty = "n"
  )
}

report_fit <- function(name, fit, S, xi, lambda) {
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(name, "\n")
  cat("iterations:", fit$iter, "\n")
  cat("final l1 change:", format(fit$l1.change, digits = 8), "\n")
  cat("first 10 components:\n")
  print(round(fit$u[1:10], 10))
  cat("KKT check:\n")
  print(kkt_check(S, xi, fit$u, lambda))
  cat("objective:", objective(S, xi, fit$u, lambda), "\n")
}

## Main computation
n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)

S <- crossprod(X) / n
xi <- xi.star

lambda <- 1.2 * sqrt(log(p) / n)

cat("lambda =", lambda, "\n")

L <- max(eigen(S, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values)
cat("lambda_max(S) =", L, "\n")
cat("1 / lambda_max(S) =", 1 / L, "\n")

## Coordinate descent
fit.cd <- coord_descent(S, xi, lambda, tol = 1e-5)
report_fit("Coordinate descent", fit.cd, S, xi, lambda)

## Proximal gradient
taus <- c(0.01, 0.005, 0.001)

fits.pg <- vector("list", length(taus))

for (m in seq_along(taus)) {
  tau <- taus[m]

  if (tau > 1 / L) {
    warning(paste("tau =", tau, "is larger than 1/lambda_max(S)."))
  }

  fits.pg[[m]] <- prox_grad(S, xi, lambda, tau = tau, tol = 1e-5)

  report_fit(
    paste0("Proximal gradient, tau = ", tau),
    fits.pg[[m]],
    S,
    xi,
    lambda
  )
}

## Plots of coordinates j = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot_path(fit.cd, main = "Coordinate descent")

for (m in seq_along(taus)) {
  plot_path(
    fits.pg[[m]],
    main = paste0("Proximal gradient, tau = ", taus[m])
  )
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

The stationary condition is checked by the printed quantity `max_KKT_violation`. For a successfully converged solution, this should be close to \(0\). The printed `max_fixed_point_residual` checks the equivalent proximal fixed-point condition
\[
u=\mathcal S_{\alpha\lambda}\{u-\alpha(Su-\xi)\}.
\]
